Package model.logic.abstraction

Class AbstractComposite

java.lang.Object
model.logic.abstraction.AbstractFormal
model.logic.abstraction.AbstractComposite
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Formal>, Formal
Direct Known Subclasses:
Composite
public abstract class AbstractComposite extends AbstractFormal
Provides the functionality of a composite. The only left to implement is the constructor. REMARK ON STRANGE IMPLEMENTATION DECISION: This class carries a lot of descriptive functionality in the form of a of s on behalf of its abstract super class just for the sake of code readability which it never use but only hides away. The most prominent risk is to confuse the instance composite value variable in the class with the the class it inherits, that contains another of s that also most often represents the same composite matheamtics value.
This is strange and could well be semantically aligned later but makes source files much more maintainable now.
